# LOG-003: Journal disk use

- **Group:** Logs and monitoring
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Shows how much disk the journal uses now so it can be compared with the cap in LOG-001.

## Verify by hand

```sh
journalctl --disk-usage
```

## How to fix it

None; informational.

Run `stackward explain LOG-003` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
